🚀 NASA Space Apps Challenge

We are a multidisciplinary team from Peru participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project focuses on developing an AI-powered interactive platform integrating NASA datasets, geospatial analysis, and geological information to identify and evaluate lunar and Martian terrain analogs, including sites in Peru. Our goal is to support safer, more efficient space exploration through scientific analysis, engineering solutions, and data-driven decision-making.
